title: nenova.exe 출고 진단·분배 연도 스코프 계약

actions.name: DISTRIBUTION_PRODUCT_DISPLAY
actions.description: 품목 패널 폭/줄바꿈 및 선택 품종과 같은 맨 앞 접두어만 표시 축약. EXE BeforeStock인 _exeParity.prevStock을 입고 옆/전차수 열에 그대로 표시하며 입고를 빼지 않는다. legacy 현재 snapshot은 전차수로 추정하지 않는다. SQL/저장/자동분배/수량 계산 보존.

actions.name: IMPORT_PIVOT_FOOTER_CUSTOMER_LABEL
actions.description: 검증 후 피벗 하단 합계에 상단과 동일한 model.customers 순서의 c.name과 기존 c.uploadQty를 표시한다. 필터 범위/수량/환산/API/SQL/저장 및 연도 업무키는 변경하지 않는다.

actions.name: ALSTRO_EXPLICIT_ERP_QUANTITY_IMPORT
actions.description: A2='알스트로 ERP 수량 (÷16 참고)'로 표식된 신규 파일만 alstroErpQuantity=true를 파싱한다. preview/preflight/transaction은 normalizeUploadQtyForProduct 공통 정책으로 실제 수량을 보존한다. 구형 파일은 16배, 동일 업무키의 혼합 인코딩은 차단. 중국 CL 행은 수량 데이터에서 제외한다.

actions.name: DISTRIBUTE_IMPORT_PREVIEW_FIXED_ALERT
actions.description: 엑셀 업로드 후 검증하기는 preview와 apply가 공유하는 확정 범위 판정 결과에 확정차단 행이 있으면 연도·세부차수·업체·품목·건수와 확정취소 후 재검증 안내를 즉시 표시한다.

actions.name: DISTRIBUTE_IMPORT_FINAL_APPLY
actions.description: 명시된 연도·차수의 엑셀을 최종 분배표로 한 트랜잭션에 저장한다. 양수는 주문과 분배의 최종값으로 맞추고, 0·빈칸·행누락은 주문등록값을 보존하면서 분배만 0으로 처리한다. 파일 전체를 분배만 반영하는 별도 모드는 허용하지 않는다.
actions.stalePreview: block_entire_batch_on_unexpected_shipment_drift; active current-year orders are always preserved and their quantity drift does not block shipment final-state SET
actions.orderWritePolicy: active current-year OrderDetail exists => preserve order and apply shipment only; no active order + positive shipment target => create positive order then apply shipment; zero target never creates or changes order
actions.verification: shipment_final_quantity_and_date before commit and after commit; post-commit query error or mismatch must return success=false; existing orders are quantity-preserved; newly required orders verify positive active-row existence only
actions.categoryReplacement: selected year/week and matched Product.CountryFlower categories: include every existing customer/product pair, including products entirely removed from the file; send all preview rows and verify the complete category before and after commit; unexpected nonzero pairs fail verification; fixed rows block the whole replacement
actions.replacementAuthorization: public upload apply requires an actor-bound, 30-minute HMAC of every preview row and early-shipment scope plus current matchPolicy catalog-original-name-v2; pre-fix signed previews require revalidation before any write; unmatched/fixed preview cannot authorize; fullCategoryReplacement cannot be disabled; raw shipment coverage is checked before writing and again under transaction locks; any late fixed row aborts rather than skips
actions.priorImportLineageScope: superseded by categoryReplacement; historical sheet/keymap must not expand the current matched category scope
actions.customerColumnChoice: Explicit original unmatched customer label only: include by selecting ERP customer, or ignore that source column for this file. Never auto-ignore early-shipment labels; preserve ordinary columns and existing category missing-to-zero policy; canceled choice requires revalidation.
actions.manualProductChoice: Active manual ProdKey overrides source family and workbook key; invalid choice remains unmatched. Unique original catalog names override inferred species. After family correction, recover old manual/invalid/skip choice only for one source family and one saved choice with identical sheet and normalized label. Exact current key wins; ambiguous recovery blocks for renewed choice.
actions.explicitProductSkip: Explicit per-file label skip removes source rows. Signed remaining matched product keys define replacement; skipped and out-of-file products preserve all ledgers. Included products retain missing-customer-to-zero policy. All-skipped has no plan. Same known ProdKey include/skip conflict blocks.
actions.automaticProductFamily: Original full catalog name wins over inferred row/heading species and cleaned aliases. Exact duplicates require unique country/species heading, source family, or one positive order for the current year/week/customer; otherwise stay unmatched. Never rank ambiguous file candidates or fall through from exact duplicates to fuzzy. Unknown detailed names cannot resolve to generic species products. Explicit conflicting workbook keys block; manual choices remain authoritative. Preserve Ruscus size aliases, matched DB quantity family, signed scope and native writes. Full 3359-product/6175-name snapshot verifies exact keys in both 2025 and 2026.

actions.name: DISTRIBUTE_IMPORT_ROLLBACK
actions.description: 관리자가 불변 전후 스냅샷과 현재 원장을 대조한 뒤 업로드 한 건 전체를 적용 전 상태로 되돌린다. 업로드 이후 변경이 하나라도 있으면 전체를 중단한다.

actions.name: IMPORT_DUPLICATE_REVIEW
actions.description: Original duplicate candidates remain visible after matching with ProdKey/country/species/unit and current-year/week file-customer positive-order evidence. Existing productOverrides permits corrections and invalidates signed preview. No catalog merge/delete or persistent default.

actions.name: IMPORT_DEPLOY_DRAIN
actions.description: Shared OS lease covers import audit initialization through final verification/audit. Deployment closes admission, waits exclusively before restart; timeout preserves running app. Missing progress is unknown, never automatic replay.
actions.yearFixture: 2025 and 2026 44-01 arguments preserved verbatim by lease wrapper

crossYearFixture.description: 2025와 2026에 같은 OrderWeek가 있어도 진단·분배 조회·확정검사·사후검증은 선택한 OrderYear만 읽고 쓴다. 다른 연도 후보는 별도로 표시한다.
